verdict.rationale: Letta is presented as a platform/framework (Agent SDK, self-hosted App Server) that already exposes an OpenAI-compatible API and an ACP adapter for clients like Zed, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible feature for this kind of product — the axis applies. However, no evidence in the pack mentions an MCP server, MCP endpoint, or MCP-based connection method; only OpenAI-compatible and ACP integrations are documented.
